NULL_target_definition: For a clean labelled prior history object: no matching current clean GT observation. Unlabelled or mixed histories are masked.
existence_target_definition: Matching current clean observation OR missed+1 <= registered max_missed; this is retention-policy supervision, not direct physical existence.
NULL_trained_probability_definition: sigmoid(null_logit[q] - max_j assignment_logit[q,j]); when no current observations the source uses current=0. Raw sigmoid(null_logit) or null_logit>=0 is not this trained NULL probability.
birth_probability_views: Report both sigmoid(birth_logit) binary prior and the softmax over historical assignment logits plus birth class, then actual constrained solver choices.
